justification: A serving change: the plan brief route now answers only for 10 named councils, a house, zone R2, and skips 114 listed clauses; plus two reworked outreach checks. Not Minor: it changes what a visitor sees and what a public claim measures. Not Critical: nothing is written to the database and the change is reversible by editing one JSON file.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/lib/plan-brief-scope.test.ts && cd .. && python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-29 && python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-30
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The route serves the brief outside the named councils, house or zone R2, a skipped clause is still returned, a flagged clause would still be shown for a named council, a core topic has no clause left, or recall on the proven rules after the skip falls under the bars.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutation 1 (scope always true) failed 1 of 6 tests; mutation 2 (nothing dropped) failed 2 of 6; both restored to green. Before the keyword rules were tightened OC-29 printed FAIL (a never-scanned topic, then recall 89%) and OC-30 printed FAIL (hold-out 17/20 = 85%); after, both print PASS. Full Jest: 210 suites, 2,571 tests pass.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads project_brief_rows and regulatory_provisions (read-only); the skip list is a JSON file in the repo; nothing is deleted or written.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a council is renamed or a clause id changes, the skip list silently stops matching; the OC-29 check fails when a live clause is not in the recorded scan.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every brief request after deploy; rows in the table are untouched.
pre_impl.frontend_type: StoredBriefRow is unchanged; two pure helpers were added.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A visitor in an unnamed council, another project type or zone sees no brief and the existing proven figures and full plan; never a wrong-type clause.

functions.name: heading_read
functions.input: the scope file, the recorded heading scan and the live brief rows
functions.output: PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN with the reason
functions.if_none: a missing or malformed file reads FAIL; an unreachable database reads UNKNOWN

functions.name: _served_scope
functions.input: the brief-scope JSON file in the frontend shared folder
functions.output: the named councils and skipped clause ids, or nothing
functions.if_none: returns nothing, so recall is measured on all rows as before

values.if_missing: the build fails on the missing JSON import

break_it.scenario: A keyword rule flags a right clause and costs a proven rule.
break_it.what_happens: Recall falls and the right clause disappears.
break_it.how: OC-30 measures recall after the skip; three false-positive rules were found that way and tightened.

break_it.scenario: A keyword rule misses a wrong-type heading.
break_it.what_happens: A wrong clause stays in the brief.
break_it.how: Known limit: the rules are keywords (Cumberland outbuildings was missed until added); recorded in the scope file limits and the ledger note.
break_it.repro: python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-29 after adding an unflagged wrong clause to the scan

break_it.scenario: The brief is rebuilt or reloaded after the scan.
break_it.what_happens: New clauses were never read against headings.
break_it.how: heading_read fails when any live top-5 clause is absent from the scan.
break_it.repro: python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-29 after a reload

break_it.scenario: A visitor asks for a project type or zone outside the scope.
break_it.what_happens: They could be served unread clauses.
break_it.how: inBriefScope returns false so the route returns an empty list; covered by plan-brief-scope.test.ts.

break_it.scenario: The serving-scope file is deleted or malformed.
break_it.what_happens: A public claim could be measured on an unrelated dataset.
break_it.how: OC-30 and OC-29 return FAIL when the scope file is missing or malformed; no fallback to the unscoped data.
break_it.repro: python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-30 with the scope file renamed

post_merge.manual_verify: With NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAN_BRIEF and PLAN_BRIEF on in a preview, open a Penrith house address: a brief shows; open a Campbelltown address: none shows.
